human_feedback.exact: 为什么越改越差。你自己检查下。你的方向是不是越来越乱了

diagnosis: The project confused visible delta with quality improvement. M02 was penalized for small change even though fidelity was its purpose.
After M03, the experiment began optimizing method novelty rather than closeness to the approved mother visual character.
M04 changed the base DNA entirely and produced a decorated-font result.
M06 introduced a new historical/chisel design language that was not anchored to the approved mother and therefore increased divergence.
The method queue became the driver; the fixed visual target stopped being the driver.
